note: Hand-classified eval-mechanism per corpus repo (R71, corrected R72+R72b; boundary rule applied R80). mechanism ∈ {built-in-module, hand-rolled, external-harness, benchmark-run, none}. judge: 'yes' iff an LLM-based judging/grading component exists IN THE REPO (shipped/hand-rolled), not merely a user-extensible harness. validation: human-ground-truth validation accompanies eval practice. Boundary rule (R80): a manifest-declared dep is an external harness iff its integration point in the repo is an evaluation module; callback/telemetry integrations (langfuse/opik/langsmith/wandb/promptlayer/uptrain) are tracing. judge.definition: Presence of LLM-based judging/grading (LLM evaluates outputs): 'yes' if a judge/grading mechanism exists in the repo (hand-rolled code, built-in module, or via harness); 'no' otherwise.

validation.definition: Human-ground-truth validation accompanies judge-based evaluation: 'yes' if human-annotated references, agreement metrics (kappa/inter-rater), calibration, or golden sets are present in eval code; 'no' otherwise.
